title: Connected encoded graph
statement: For a natural number $v$, an encoded graph on the vertex set $\{0,1,\ldots,v-1\}$ is connected if, for every pair of vertices, there is a finite chain of vertices from the first to the second in which each consecutive pair is adjacent according to the encoded graph.
